scope: historical CSIC development, held endpoint fold zero, records used by neither earlier panel
training: 16 seed-matched benchmark bad, 16 benchmark good, 32 unmarked; simulated review

panel.label_use: The benchmark label selected the two strata by seeded hash. No score was read. Decisions are frozen before outcomes are joined for evaluation.
panel.known_limit: Nearly all held good records are on one endpoint, so it dominates the panel, and records elsewhere are mostly positive. Every held endpoint is absent from the history by the fold's construction.

score_order: diagnostic MarkSet ratio descending, then original SHA256

arms.score: the first b records in score order
arms.candidate: Reservation of n slots for records the product routed as Unsupported, taken in score order. The remaining b - n slots, and any reservation slots left empty, are filled in score order from the records not yet taken. Always b records.
arms.control: As the candidate, with the reservation filled without any encoder: records ordered by the number of panel records on their endpoint ascending, then score order.
arms.policy_separate: the product policy with its own unsupported slots, as in task 2.24

allocation: One product run at budget 12 under the shared rule supplies routes and evidence. The policy arm at each budget is recomputed from that evidence and validated by the product.

tests.primary: At each budget and for both reservation sizes: positives found by the candidate and not by score alone against positives found by score alone and not by the candidate. Exact two-sided sign test on these discordant positives. All ten results are reported. Budgets are nested.
tests.control: The same paired comparison between the candidate and the control. If they do not differ, the vector evidence is not shown to add anything over the endpoint on this fold.
tests.replication: The task 2.24 question and statistic with 40 score bins, 9,999 permutations of the unsupported flag within bins, seed 225: once on the whole panel and once on the records of the endpoint with the most panel records. For the records on other endpoints only counts are reported, because they are too few for bins.

selection: Freeze all selections for every budget before joining held benchmark outcomes.
qualification: exploratory; no operational targets, no pass/fail threshold, no final holdout
